integration_instructions: Inspect the exact research-attempt records and every accepted source record before integrating each model; use one exact model/source at a time.
Reuse accepted evidence only when it directly establishes the frozen exact model and field. Preserve source class, exact trim, size/basis, date, geography, options, and caveats.
Do not refresh source dates, infer missing values, merge sibling models, or convert a foreign price into a mainland offer.
If any accepted source is missing, mismatched, or insufficient, leave that field unresolved and state the precise reason; do not conduct new broad research within this frozen integration batch.
No image rights inference or image addition unless source metadata explicitly supports reuse. No external GitHub mutation or publication.
done_criteria: Inspect all 17 frozen evidence-found fields. Integrate only exact supported facts and dated/source-linked observations; leave unsupported fields explicitly unresolved. Write a result matrix, accept monotonic coverage after data/source changes, run npm run check once for this coherent batch, and run npm run image:report if image records change.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
